clue.text: Excellent meal, lacking one prawn starter and a bit of bacon

indicators.note: lacking says a letter is missing from the word for the meal

parts.note: supper is an evening meal

indicators.note: a starter is what comes first, so the opening letter of prawn is taken
a bit of bacon is just one letter of it, here the opening one

explanation.surface: A disappointing dinner that turns up without its prawn cocktail and with barely any bacon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one prawn starter' is the single P removed from SUPPER, leaving SUPER, to which B is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Superb and excellent are synonyms, both meaning of the highest quality.

clue.text: A French right to be wrong

parts.note: un is the French for a
true means correct or right

explanation.surface: Someone claims a Frenchman's entitlement to make mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Untrue is a synonym of wrong in the sense of false or incorrect.

clue.text: Forced out by former girlfriend in a hurry

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
pressed, as in pressed for time, means hurried

explanation.surface: Someone was pushed out of a place by an ex who was rushing.
explanation.definitionFit: To express juice is to squeeze or force it out, so expressed means forced out.

clue.text: Clear one's mind

parts.note: literally washing out the brain, punning on indoctrination that wipes a person's previous beliefs

explanation.definitionFit: Indoctrinating someone wipes their beliefs away, a literal clearing out of the mind.

clue.text: Renegade state embraced by Irishman

indicators.note: embraced by puts the word for state inside the name for an Irishman

parts.note: Mick is a slang name for an Irishman
to aver is to state or assert

explanation.surface: A rebel's declaration is warmly received by a man from Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A maverick is an unorthodox independent who breaks from the herd, a renegade.

clue.text: The colour of leading actor surrounded by scandal

indicators.note: surrounded by puts the leading actor inside the scandal

parts.note: mud is scandalous talk, as in mudslinging
the star is the leading actor in a production

explanation.surface: A newspaper wonders what shade a disgraced lead actor's reputation has become.
explanation.definitionFit: Mustard is a dark yellow shade, named after the condiment.

clue.text: Face protection for guest without it

indicators.note: without means the word it is taken away from the guest

parts.note: a visitor is a guest
taken as written

explanation.surface: A host offers a mask for a guest who has come without one.
explanation.definitionFit: A visor is a shield worn over the face, as on a helmet.

clue.text: Set a date to go into port

indicators.note: to go into puts the date inside the port

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port
AD, anno domini, marks a date in years

explanation.surface: A captain fixes a day for arriving at harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A radio is a receiving set, so set names one.

clue.text: Church work is duplicated quickly

indicators.note: is duplicated says the church-and-work pair appears twice in a row

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Some ecclesiastical work gets copied fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Chop-chop is an informal command meaning hurry up, so quickly.

clue.text: Best space on board — just temporary measures

indicators.note: on, read with board, means aboard ship, so the other pieces go inside the ship letters

parts.note: in the phrase on board, the vessel boarded is the steamship, abbreviated SS
top means best
a gap is a space

explanation.surface: Someone praises the finest berth on a ship as only a passing arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is the crossword convention for going inside SS, a steamship.
explanation.definitionFit: Stopgaps are makeshift expedients that fill in until something lasting is found.

clue.text: People who aren't cool contribute during emergency call

parts.note: SOS is the international distress signal
to add is to contribute

clue.text: Mixture encrusted around a serving dish

clue.text: Service broadcast on behalf of church

for means on behalf of
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A religious service is put out on radio for a congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: The air force is one of the armed services.

clue.text: Obscure rights of chief to hang

indicators.note: rights here are the right-hand ends, the final letters of each word

clue.text: Limited accommodation for replacement stablehand?

a groom looks after horses

explanation.definitionFit: Standing room is space where only standing is possible, a restricted form of accommodation.

clue.text: Having abnormal growths due to land being bad

clue.text: Oxide from little-known planet

parts.note: rare means uncommon or seldom encountered
Earth is our planet

clue.text: Bad, if one turns out to be genuine

indicators.note: turns out says these letters are turned round into a new order

explanation.surface: Something poor may prove to be the real thing after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Bona fide is Latin for in good faith, meaning authentic or genuine.

clue.text: Ignore carbon dated joint

clue.text: Short fat girl

parts.note: suet is hard animal fat used in cooking

explanation.surface: An unkind description of a small, plump young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Sue is a girl's name, the crossword sense of girl.

clue.text: Sausage rolls at last — French style, note

mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Sausage rolls finally prepared the French way, as a menu note explains.

clue.text: Criminal had a nice spread

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.definitionFit: An image is the general impression a person or brand presents to the public.

clue.text: Reminder from head of government, wearing nothing

clue.text: Important stuff
